lines.en: I make my way to the library first thing in the morning to see how Futaba is doing.
lines.zh: 一大早我就去图书馆看 Futaba 在做什么。

lines.en: It's incredibly warm inside but she's bundled up regardless. I honestly have no idea how she isn't burning to death.
lines.zh: 里面热得要命，她却还是裹得严严实实。我是真不知道她怎么没被活活热死。

lines.en: Without anyone else in the library, which is apparently just how it is this time of year, we spend our time doing something absolutely disgusting.
lines.zh: 图书馆里一个人都没有——这个季节似乎向来如此——于是我们把时间花在了一件极其恶心的事情上。

lines.en: That's right, ladies and gentlemen- we speak at a normal volume.
lines.zh: 没错，女士们先生们——我们用正常的音量说话。

lines.en: I mean, why keep our voices down when there's no one around to realize how sick and twisted we are?
lines.zh: 我是说，既然没人在场发现我们有多变态多扭曲，那又何必压低声音呢？

lines.en: Futaba and I leave the library for a few minutes and walk around the halls of the[school] on an off-day, something that will never cease to make me feel odd and out-of-place.
lines.zh: Futaba 和我离开图书馆一会儿，在没有课的[school]走廊里逛了逛——这种事总让我觉得别扭又格格不入。

lines.en: In a sense, though, I'm technically out-of-place in[school] to begin with. Just now there are less people around to notice it.
lines.zh: 不过从某种意义上说，我本来在[school]里就是个格格不入的存在。只不过现在人少，没人注意到罢了。

lines.en: We eventually come back to the library to find a couple of girls from a different class trying to get in from the outside.
lines.zh: 我们最后回到图书馆，发现几个别班的女生正想从外面进来。

lines.en: Futaba apologizes profusely for making them wait out in the cold and, after hearing her apologize roughly seven more times, I realize I have overstayed my welcome.
lines.zh: Futaba 为让她们在冷风里等着连连道歉；听她又道了大概七次歉之后，我意识到自己在这儿待太久了。

lines.en: I bid goodbye to all three of them and quickly make my way back outside, wondering what I should do next...
lines.zh: 我跟她们三个道了别，快步走回室外，琢磨着接下来该干点什么……
Futaba 的好感度提升到了 [futaba_love]!
